profile.headline: Software Engineer at TTS, LLC
profile.summary: I am a talented and driven young IT professional looking for opportunities in either application development focusing on Microsoft's .NET platform or SQL DBA / developer roles. Technology has always been a passion of mine, second only to problem-solving, and I've been pleasantly surprised that the IT industry is a natural outlet for my interests.

positions.title: IT Specialist
positions.description: Responsible for managing our Citrix environment of 80 users (Citrix PS 4.5). Responsible for data-driven application development including but not limited to detailed report generation and web applications focused on supporting over 80 users. All development work (outside of legacy work which include VB) is done in ASP.NET with a C# backend.

positions.title: Support for Panasonic Arbitrator
positions.description: Provided technical support for the Panasonic Arbitrator 360 evidence collection system (dash camera and supporting system(s) in police vehicles). Wrote libraries (C) for third party radar guns to interface with Arbitrator.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Developed database monitoring software to support DBAs. All done in C#

positions.title: IT Intern
positions.description: Responsible for help tickets. Near the end of my internship with Amstan I began diving into software testing and network administration.
